sources.title: ComfyUI on DGX Spark (FLUX.2-klein-9B, uncensored text encoder)
sources.snippet: Self-hosted ComfyUI, reachable only over Tailscale, running FLUX.2-klein-9B with a community "uncensored" (abliterated) text encoder swapped in. Built from scratch for ARM64 + NVIDIA GB10 (Grace Blackwell / DGX Spark), since no pre-built ComfyUI image targets that combination yet.
